params.prompt: Facing forward, gently lift a partner in a bridal carry. Seconds 0-2 bend knees and reach one arm behind their back, other under knees. Seconds 2-4 push through legs and rise, elbows cradling the weight. Seconds 4-7 hold them close with soft breathing, a tiny reassuring sway and downward head glance. Seconds 7-10 squat slowly, lower partner to floor, release arms. No walking or spinning.

Being gently lifted in a bridal carry by a partner. Begin standing, reach arms toward their shoulders. Seconds 2-4 curl knees up, lean back slightly and turn sideways into their arms. Seconds 4-7 relax with head leaning toward partner, small breathing and a relaxed ankle movement. Seconds 7-10 uncurl legs gradually to stand, then release shoulders. Smooth gentle motion, no jumping.
